learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to listen to the beautiful sounds around us and find joy in little things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: There are so many wonderful sounds in our world. From birds chirping to bells ringing every sound has its own magic.
Little bells make a happy tinkling sound. Listening to sweet sounds can make our minds feel peaceful and happy.

fun_activity.title: 🎼 Find the Sound
fun_activity.instructions: Close your eyes for one minute and listen carefully. Try to guess at least three different sounds you hear around you!

quick_recap: ⭐ Our ears help us enjoy beautiful sounds.
⭐ Bells make a cheerful and happy noise.
⭐ We should notice the small beautiful things around us.
